limitation_notes: Surrogate gradient in spiking model is an approximation.
Latency encoding can reduce information throughput.
arith_energy_nj is an arithmetic-only estimate (4.6 pJ/MAC, 0.9 pJ/AC, Horowitz ISSCC 2014, 45 nm fp32) from counted operations; memory traffic is not included.
spike_rate is the spiking fraction of the hidden LIF (neuron, step) pairs; NaN for models without spiking neurons.
Evaluation depends on available FSDD/PhysioNet files under dataset_root.
